units.source_text: 這種傷痕自襁褓時就長在我的一條腿上，

en.t: This wound had been on one of my legs since I was an infant,

units.source_text: 隨著長大非但沒有痊癒，反而日趨嚴重，並深入骨髓，

en.t: and as I grew older, instead of healing, it only grew worse day by day and sank deep into the marrow,

units.source_text: 每晚的痛苦如同掉進千變萬化的地獄，

en.t: so that every night's pain was like falling into a hell of endlessly changing forms,

units.source_text: 但是（這種說法有點奇怪）這種傷痕逐漸變得比自己的血肉還要親密，

en.t: but, though it sounds strange to say so, the wound gradually became more intimate to me than my own flesh and blood,

units.source_text: 傷痕的疼痛就像它活生生的情感，甚或是痴情的低語。

en.t: and the pain of the wound seemed like its own living emotion, or even the whisper of a lover.

units.source_text: 對我這樣的男人而言，地下運動組織的氣氛讓我感到格外的安心與愜意。

en.t: For a man like me, the atmosphere of the underground movement organization felt oddly reassuring and comfortable.

units.source_text: 總之，比起地下運動的內在目的，那種運動的外皮更適合我。

en.t: In short, more than the inner purpose of the underground movement, it was that movement's outer skin that suited me.
